0.name: TEXT_REGWILTHEWAKINGSANDS_00131_TATARU_000_000
0.description: Please be advised that this is private property. Unless you have pertinent business here, I must ask you to leave.
0.translation_description: Ti avviso che questa è una proprietà privata. Se non hai una questione importante da sbrigare qui, devo chiederti di andartene.

1.name: TEXT_REGWILTHEWAKINGSANDS_00131_TATARU_000_010
1.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! How goes it? All's well here! ...At least on the bookkeeping front, anyway.
1.translation_description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Come va? Qui è tutto a posto! ...Almeno per quanto riguarda i registri contabili, ecco.

2.name: TEXT_REGWILTHEWAKINGSANDS_00131_TATARU_000_020
2.description: Some people let fame swell their heads, but I believe that yours will remain in proportion <hex:021A020203>and<hex:021A020103> firmly attached to your body!
2.translation_description: La fama dà alla testa a molti, ma sono certa che la tua resterà proporzionata <hex:021A020203>e<hex:021A020103> ben salda al corpo!

3.name: TEXT_REGWILTHEWAKINGSANDS_00131_TATARU_000_030
3.description: Good <hex:020838E3E90C0DFF1A020816E3E90C05FF086576656E696E67FF076D6F72726F7703FF17020813E3E90C12FF04646179FF086576656E696E670303>, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! I trust your investigation is faring well!
3.translation_description: Ti auguro una buona <hex:02083DE3E90C0DFF1B020817E3E90C05FF07736572617461FF0967696F726E61746103FF1B020817E3E90C12FF0967696F726E617461FF077365726174610303>, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Spero che le tue indagini procedano bene!

4.name: TEXT_REGWILTHEWAKINGSANDS_00131_TATARU_000_040
4.description: <sigh> Our numbers have swelled so much of late, it takes an <hex:021A020203>age<hex:021A020103> to keep records up to date.<hex:02100103>...Hee hee, that rhymes!
4.translation_description: <sigh> Siamo così tanti ormai che per tenere i registri aggiornati ci vuole <hex:021A020203>un'eternità<hex:021A020103>, sai!<hex:02100103>... Ih ih, fa rima!

5.name: TEXT_REGWILTHEWAKINGSANDS_00131_TATARU_000_041
5.description: Oh, and I hope you don't mind, but I took the liberty of drawing a pretty little flower next to your name. This way I can find you quickly!
5.translation_description: E spero che non ti dispiaccia, ma mi sono permessa di disegnare un bel fiorellino accanto al tuo nome. Così ti troverò subito!

6.name: TEXT_REGWILTHEWAKINGSANDS_00131_TATARU_000_050
6.description: The entire headquarters is up in arms! I can scarce stay abreast of all the goings-on!
6.translation_description: Qui è tutto un fermento! Fatico a stare dietro a tutte le novità!

7.name: TEXT_REGWILTHEWAKINGSANDS_00131_TATARU_000_060
7.description: When you came to our rescue, I couldn't see five yalms ahead me for the tears of joy.<hex:02100103>...I need not tell you that this is strictly for your ears only!
7.translation_description: Quando ci hai salvati, avevo gli occhi così pieni di lacrime di gioia che non vedevo a cinque yalmi davanti a me.<hex:02100103>... Ma mi raccomando, non dirlo a nessuno!

8.name: TEXT_REGWILTHEWAKINGSANDS_00131_TATARU_000_070
8.description: The Garlean threat may have abated, but there is no end to the work we Scions do.
8.translation_description: La minaccia garleana si sarà anche attenuata, ma il lavoro degli Eredi non finisce mai.

9.name: TEXT_REGWILTHEWAKINGSANDS_00131_TATARU_000_071
9.description: In our own unique ways, may every one of us continue striving to make a better Eorzea!
9.translation_description: Che ciascuno di noi continui, a modo suo, a impegnarsi per rendere Eorzea un posto migliore!
